methods.contrasts: A=on-off averaged over B/C; AB=(11-10)-(01-00) averaged over C; AC/BC analogously; ABC=AB(C=1)-AB(C=0). Tables retain each budget and collection size separately; differences use family means and percentage-point plotting, not regression coefficients.
methods.controls: Full collection and sufficient-source oracle are distinct diagnostic upper-bound/context controls on twelve families, not deployable policies.
methods.discovery_grounding: IDs from complete read, retrieve, or partial-search observations replayed before final write; delivery in the write turn is excluded.
methods.exact_match_caveat: Synonyms, freeform paraphrases and list order can fail exact authored matching; scores are not semantic factual equivalence.
methods.fixed_budget_ceiling: Minimum byte size of an authored sufficient-original set bounds the frozen bundle outcome; authored sets are non-exhaustive. A also adds packet serialization bytes. Feasible-query ratios resample whole-family success and feasible counts, without replacing the primary outcome.
methods.primary_reader_metric: exact authored answer/status plus sufficient valid original-source citations, artifact write, structural check, clean finish and zero forbidden virtual attempts
methods.provider_usage: Provider usage fields are retained separately. Reasoning tokens are not added to output totals; no derived sum assumes whether provider fields overlap.
methods.resampling_unit: whole semantic family; retain both queries and all paired cells
methods.scope: conditional on this non-random LLM-authored bank; no multiplicity correction; no population or causal-generalization claim
methods.timing: 144 uncached warmed rank/pack observations on six development families; no cached rank receipts used for speed
methods.token_counts: Reconstructed local tokenizer text-only counts with no truncation/special tokens; not Muse billable usage.
methods.unknown_usage: Missing infrastructure usage is unknown, never a fabricated zero.
methods.weighting: equal family means; reader uses one selected query per family

narrative_ready_findings.timing: Only 144 separately executed uncached development observations support warm rank/pack latency comparisons.

narrative_ready_findings.statement: Primary reader metric is exact authored value/status plus valid sufficient original sources and clean completion. Synonyms and list ordering can fail exact match without showing semantic factual disagreement.
Index cues consume packet bytes. A contrasts combine retrieval-cue benefit and serialization cost under a fixed budget; non-exhaustive authored sufficient sets define the scored feasibility ceiling.
Conditional descriptive results for 48 LLM-authored family clusters; 36 held-out. No universal engine winner, representative vault inference, or semantic-reader accuracy claim follows.
